title: antennaria alpina var. compacta
intro: Antennaria alpina var. compacta, commonly known as Mountain Elbow Joint-root, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to North America. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Elbow Joint-root include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, Antennaria alpina var. compacta has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including sore throats, coughs, and skin irritations.
